# Vulcanus Base Blueprints

A growing collection of blueprints designed specifically for a main base on **Vulcanus**, which—let's be honest—is way better than Nauvis. These blueprints are optimized for the unique progression and resources of Vulcanus and currently require access to **Electromagnetic Plants**. (Assembler-based versions may come later.)

---

## 🔧 Changelog

### \[v0.2.0] – Up to Utility (Yellow) Science
This release includes:

* All Nauvis Sciences
* LDS Production
* Robot Frame Production
* Vulcanus Intermediatory Item Production (Tungsten & Carbon)
### \[v0.1.0] – Up to Production (Blue) Science

This early release includes:

* Red, Green, and Blue Science setups
* All Circuit production lines
* A few helpful utility blueprints

I'm releasing this version early to gather feedback and suggestions. More science packs and full base progression blueprints are on the way—stay tuned!
